methodology: Articles sourced from Virginia-specific RSS feeds and Google News RSS, filtered for AI/technology/workforce relevance, then assessed by Claude against the scenario framework. Each article is tagged with the region it most affects and the scenario it signals toward.

signals.title: Roanoke College launches WorkAI Lab to prepare leaders for new era of technology - Roanoke College
signals.signal_reading: Roanoke College's WorkAI Lab represents intentional capability-building infrastructure outside metro hubs, potentially seeding peer-to-peer learning networks that could distribute deep AI fluency beyond traditional tech corridors.

signals.title: Norfolk native brings free AI workshops to Hampton Roads to close the technology gap - WTKR
signals.signal_reading: A Norfolk native returning to deliver free AI workshops signals grassroots knowledge distribution through community networks, creating pathways for deep engagement beyond platform-mediated shallow adoption in a non-metro region.

signals.title: New partnership between VCU and AI Ready RVA aims to boost AI education, innovation and community impact - VCU News
signals.signal_reading: VCU's partnership with AI Ready RVA concentrates educational infrastructure and innovation capacity in Richmond Metro, deepening capabilities in an existing hub rather than distributing them to underserved regions.

signals.title: Virginia’s technical workforce faces uncertainty as funding runs out for middle school program
signals.signal_reading: GO TEC's potential termination in Southside due to funding loss exemplifies how fragile technical workforce development remains in rural Virginia, signaling neither depth nor distribution where it's needed most for economic transition.

signals.title: TAYLOR: AI data centers increase Virginia’s urban-rural divide - The Cavalier Daily
signals.signal_reading: Commentary explicitly naming AI data centers as drivers of urban-rural divide confirms concentration dynamics, where NoVA captures infrastructure benefits while distribution mechanisms to rural regions remain absent or theoretical.
